characters.name: Bjørnen
characters.description: Bjørnen is large and stocky with a thick coat of brown fur. He appears a bit slow and gullible, with a gentle expression on his face marked by small, dark eyes and a large nose. In the ice-setting scene, he sits with his short, thick tail firmly stuck in the ice, looking confused and cold. Throughout the story, he’s depicted lying or sitting down in grassy or snowy settings, often appearing sleepy or relaxed. His expressions range from calm to suspicious when interacting with Ræven.

characters.name: Ræven
characters.description: Ræven is sly and quick, with a lean and agile body covered in vibrant red-orange fur, white underpants, and a bushy tail. His face is characterized by sharp eyes and a mischievous grin. Throughout the images, he is depicted sneaking towards the butter tub, hidden under dense spruce branches, and devouring it with caution. Ræven's posture is often sneaky or sly, as he glances around to ensure he is not being watched. His expressions range from satisfaction to deceit as he manages to fool Bjørnen at every turn. In one image, he appears with a comically exaggerated belly, hinting at his gluttonous consumption of the butter.
